title: 第7章神兽小白
slug: 最强升级系统全本免费-最强升级系统最新章节列表
content_zh:
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得战宠‘小白狼’。”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’开启战宠系统，获得100点经验，10点真气值奖励。”
战宠：小白狼（幼）
品级：神兽
描述：拥有强大无匹的狼王之力，能召唤群狼为之使用。
“我去！”
“神兽，他母亲也只是九级妖兽，他竟然是神兽，莫非是因为天地灵果的原因？”龙飞震惊起来。
九级妖兽要想进阶神级妖兽非常的困难，没有天大的机缘一辈子都没戏。
小白狼刚刚出生，吞食天地灵果就直接进阶神兽品级，这天地灵果的威力也太强悍了。
龙飞也幸好没有贪婪吃掉，否则的话他现在的修为肉身根本承受不住天地灵果浑厚的能量，直接会把他的身体给撑爆掉。
小白狼依偎在龙飞的怀里，酣睡的香甜，完全把龙飞当着母亲了。
龙飞也是淡淡一笑，自语道：“从今往后你就是我龙飞的兄弟，我会照顾你一生的。”
对那头白狼母亲也说道：“你就放心的去吧，我不会让任何人欺负小白狼的。”
欺负神兽？
这个世界上有几个能欺负神兽的人？
他不欺负人就算烧高香了。
小白狼现在还是幼崽，就算拥有神兽等级也没用，他需要成长，和龙飞一样需要突破升级，他的力量才会越来越强，也会为之进化。
龙飞将小白狼放进战宠空间，他身体卷缩着继续酣睡。

“升级，升级！”
“把技能等级能提升的都提升一下。”
当务之急还是要升级。
他想要拿起屠龙刀只有升级一条路可走，只有等级提升上来，他才能提升腕力，将一万三千斤重的屠龙刀拿起来。
“轰！”
“蛤蟆功，绞杀！”
“砰！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’击杀‘铁甲虫’获得经验90点，真气9点，能量值1点。”
“屠龙刀法。”
“第一式，开皮。”
以棍成刀，以真气催动，一棍劈下，重击在一头妖兽身上，于此同时棍子上积攒着一层只有龙飞可以看见的刀气。
那头妖兽皮开肉绽，直接被秒杀。
“叮！”
“熟练度+1”
“呼……”龙飞满头大汗，浑身像是累虚脱了一样，屠龙刀法极度消耗精神力和体力，真气，不过它的伤害简直爆表。
“不管如何，再能都要修炼下去，技能等级越高，伤害就越强。”
痛苦，并快乐着。
不断的斩杀，随着修为的提升，龙飞开始尝试猎杀二级妖兽，每次出手都将‘基础剑法’释放出来。
随后就是‘蛤蟆功’，紧接着就是‘屠龙刀法’。
技能的熟练度一点一点提升。

五个月后。
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’升级，目前等级五级战师。”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’基础剑法提升为八级。”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’蛤蟆功提升为二级。”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’屠龙刀法提升为一级。”
连续几道提示音响起。
龙飞查看了一番，暗自兴奋起来，“伤害值全都提升了，哈哈哈……五级战师，在龙家年轻一辈的弟子当中谁能与我一战？”
“我龙飞报仇的时候到了！”
出来半年多，龙飞的脑海里每天都回绕着在龙家发生的事情。
龙神血脉被神秘强者剥离。
龙家上下对他的转变，处处打压，嘲笑，排挤，连李三那样的下人都敢欺负自己。
在火璃城更是被其他贵族弟子笑话。
这些画面不断的在他脑海里重复着。
在火璃山脉这半年多时间里，龙飞每天都在告诉自己，要拼命修炼，要杀回去，要让那些嘲笑过他的人跪下唱征服。
龙飞点燃篝火，靠着妖兽肉，焦香味四溢开来，撒上一些椒盐，再来点孜然，香味更是让人难以抗拒。
“咕咕……”

小白狼依偎在龙飞身边，两只眼睛盯着烤架上的烤肉流着口水，眼睛都不带眨一下的。
五个多月的成长，小白狼的等级并没有提升，不过被龙飞给养胖了，变成肥嘟嘟，肉球球的小狗模样，一声的白毛，甚是可爱。
“好了！”
龙飞说了一声，准备把火架上的烤肉拿下来。
他身边一道白影闪过。
一口将火架上的烤肉叼走，咬住烤肉一抽，一口吞了下去。
完全没有感觉到什么叫着烫。
吃完摇着尾巴，两只大眼睛一动不动的看着龙飞，嘻嘻道：“主人，还要。”

content_en:
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for getting the battle pet 'Little White Wolf'."
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for opening the battle pet system and gaining 100 experience points and 10 points of vitality as a reward."
Battle pet: Little White Wolf (young)
Level: Divine Beast
Description: Possessing the unparalleled power of the Wolf King, he can summon a pack of wolves for his use.
"I'll go!"
"Mythical beast, his mother is only a ninth-level monster, but he is actually a mythical beast. Is it because of the heaven and earth spirit fruit?" Long Fei was shocked.
It is very difficult for a ninth-level monster to advance to a god-level monster. If you don't have a great opportunity, you will never be able to do so.
When the little white wolf was just born, he directly advanced to the level of a divine beast after swallowing the Heaven and Earth Spirit Fruit. The power of this Heaven and Earth Spirit Fruit was too powerful.
Fortunately, Long Fei didn't eat it greedily, otherwise his current physical body would not be able to withstand the rich energy of the Heaven and Earth Spirit Fruit, and his body would explode.
The little white wolf nestled in Long Fei's arms, sleeping soundly and treating Long Fei as his mother.
Long Fei also smiled lightly and said to himself: "From now on, you are my brother, Long Fei, and I will take care of you for the rest of my life."
She also said to the white wolf's mother: "You can go with peace of mind, I won't let anyone bully the little white wolf."
Bullying a mythical beast?
How many people in this world can bully mythical beasts?
If he doesn't bully others, he will be a high-profile person.
The little white wolf is still a cub now. It is useless even if he has the level of a mythical beast. He needs to grow. Like Long Fei, he needs to break through and upgrade, so that his power will become stronger and stronger and he will evolve.
Long Fei put the little white wolf into the battle pet space, and his body curled up and continued to sleep soundly.
"Upgrade, upgrade!"
"Improve your skill level as much as possible."
The top priority still needs to be upgraded.
If he wanted to pick up the dragon-slaying knife, he had to upgrade. Only by upgrading his level could he improve his wrist strength and pick up the thirteen thousand kilograms of dragon-slaying knife.
"Boom!"
"Toad Kung Fu, strangulation!"
"Bang!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for killing the 'Iron Beetle' and gaining 90 experience points, 9 points of Qi, and 1 point of energy."
"Dragon Slaying Sword Technique."
"The first move is to open the skin."
Using a stick to turn into a sword, and using true energy to move it, the stick struck down and hit a monster beast hard. At the same time, the stick accumulated a layer of sword energy that only Long Fei could see.
The monster beast's skin was torn and its flesh was torn apart, and it was instantly killed.
"Ding!"
"Proficiency +1"
"Huh..." Long Fei was sweating profusely, and his whole body seemed to be exhausted. The dragon-slaying sword technique extremely consumed his mental and physical strength, and his true energy, but its damage was simply overwhelming.
"No matter what, you must continue to practice no matter how good you are. The higher the skill level, the stronger the damage."
Painful and happy.
Continuously killing, as his cultivation level improved, Long Fei began to try to hunt the second-level monsters, releasing his 'basic swordsmanship' every time he made a move.
Then came the 'Toad Kung Fu', followed closely by the 'Dragon Slaying Sword Technique'.
Skill proficiency improves little by little.
Five months later.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for his upgrade. He is currently a level five combat master."
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for improving his basic swordsmanship to level eight."
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for improving his toad skill to Level 2."
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for improving his dragon-slaying sword skill to level one."
Several beeps sounded in succession.
Long Fei checked it out and secretly became excited, "The damage values ​​have all been increased, hahaha... A fifth-level combat master, who among the younger disciples of the Long family can fight with me?"
"It's time for me, Long Fei, to take revenge!"
After being out for more than half a year, Long Fei's mind revolved around what happened at the Long family every day.
The dragon god's bloodline was stripped away by a mysterious strong man.
Everyone in the Long family suppressed, ridiculed, and ostracized him for his transformation. Even servants like Li San dared to bully him.
in fireLicheng was even laughed at by other noble disciples.
These images kept repeating in his mind.
During the more than half a year in the Huoli Mountains, Long Fei told himself every day that he must practice hard, fight back, and make those who had laughed at him kneel down and sing conquest.
Long Fei lit a bonfire and leaned on the monster meat. The smell of burnt meat overflowed. He sprinkled some salt and pepper and added some cumin, and the smell was even more irresistible.
"Gugu..."
The little white wolf cuddled up next to Long Fei, staring at the barbecue on the grill and drooling without blinking.
After more than five months of growth, the little white wolf's level has not improved, but it has been fattened by Long Fei, turning into a plump, fleshy puppy, with white fur, which is very cute.
"Okay!"
Long Fei said and prepared to take down the barbecue from the fire rack.
A white shadow flashed beside him.
He took the barbecue off the fire rack in one gulp, bit into the barbecue, smoked it, and swallowed it in one gulp.
I didn't feel anything hot at all.
After eating, he wagged his tail and looked at Long Fei motionlessly with his two big eyes, and said with a smile: "Master, I want more."
